ideas.pitch: An AI-powered institutional knowledge and grievance routing platform built specifically for Indian college campuses and universities.
ideas.problem_statement: Hustle Carnival Open Innovation Buildathon focusing on real-world local institution pain points.
ideas.title: CampusPulse AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting an administrative pain point familiar to the college professors and management judging the hackathon, heavily mirroring localized workflow intelligence seen in winning developer tools.

ideas.pitch: A supply chain optimization dashboard calculating transport emissions and suggesting localized green vendor routing for regional logistics.
ideas.problem_statement: Hustle Carnival Open Innovation Buildathon focused on sustainability and regional economic impact.
ideas.title: AgriRoute Carbon
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a clear measurable environmental impact metric with an interactive dashboard, a proven pattern from enterprise-focused winning logistics entries.

ideas.pitch: A walk-to-earn footfall app coupled with an AI marketing copilot designed to help small street vendors and local shop owners digitize.
ideas.problem_statement: Hustle Carnival Open Innovation Buildathon supporting regional business and local economic development.
ideas.title: LocalLanka Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers concrete civic and local commercial value with a live interactive dashboard that is extremely engaging during a 2-minute prototype demo.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision posture and joint-stress analyzer for engineering students and desk workers to prevent repetitive strain injuries.
ideas.problem_statement: Hustle Carnival Open Innovation Buildathon addressing health and wellness for engineering students.
ideas.title: BioGaitPosture
ideas.why_it_could_win: Shows genuinely hard engineering by running real-time pose estimation and confidence-gated classification directly through a standard laptop webcam.

ideas.pitch: A fast clinical triage interface featuring offline-first local data management and instant Hindi/English health screening output.
ideas.problem_statement: Hustle Carnival Open Innovation Buildathon addressing healthcare accessibility in semi-urban communities.
ideas.title: CliniTriage MultiLingual
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate regional accessibility problem with localized language triage, matching the high-scoring criteria of practical healthcare hackathon winners.
